speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy struggling with feeding and having a swollen belly. To help me understand what is wrong, can you tell me if you are passing gas or having bowel movements recently?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception.

The clinical presentation of an 8-month-old with feeding difficulties, abdominal distension, and severe pain upon palpation is highly suggestive of intussusception. I am requesting an ultrasound to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.
